note: A frozen skull flies to the place aimed at (or to the first enemy) and bursts for cold damage, leaving chilled ground that burns and slows for five seconds and creeps toward nearby enemies; up to ten patches at once.

def.name: Rime Drift
def.description: A frozen skull that bursts and leaves chilled ground that creeps toward enemies.

note: A counter-attack the character cannot use on purpose: when it is hit, there is a chance it strikes every enemy around it; it waits 1.2 seconds between strikes.

def.name: Anvil Drop
def.description: A counter-attack you cannot use on purpose: when you are hit, it may strike every enemy around you.

note: An arrow that snares what it hits: a snared enemy moves 40% more slowly (up to three snares) and takes 15% to 20% more damage from projectile attacks.

def.name: Snare Shot
def.description: An arrow that snares its target: it slows, and takes more from projectile attacks.

note: A wall of ice across the way for three to five seconds: nothing walks through it; what stood under it is hit and pushed back. It waits three seconds between casts.

def.name: Glacier Wall
def.description: Raises a wall of ice across the way: nothing crosses it, and what stood under it is hit and pushed back.

note: A counter-attack that triggers by itself when the character blocks: a single strike, with both weapons when dual wielding, at most once in 0.8 seconds.

def.name: Rime Rebuke
def.description: When you block, you strike back.

note: A two-handed swing in a full circle that always knocks enemies back.

def.name: Halo Sweep
def.description: A heavy swing all around you that throws enemies back.

note: A wave of divine fire along a line, then consecrated ground and a burst about the target, and a larger shockwave that hits the enemies on the ground the wave missed for 25% less damage.

def.name: Cleansing Blaze
def.description: A wave of purifying fire, then a burst and a shockwave over consecrated ground.

note: Lobs an orb to the spot aimed at; it bursts where it lands, then bounces on the same way and bursts again, whether or not an enemy is there (two or three bursts in all).

def.name: Slag Lob
def.description: A molten orb that bursts where it lands, and bounces on to burst again.

note: Hold to charge up to five stages, 150% more damage for each; letting go looses one piercing arrow that leaves a spore pod per stage along its way, and each pod blooms into nine thorn arrows for half damage.

def.name: Blight Hail
def.description: Hold the shot to build it up; letting go looses one piercing arrow, much stronger for every stage built.

note: A projectile that turns toward the enemies ahead and pierces them, leeching a share of its damage as energy shield, and afflicts every enemy about it with a short, strong chaos damage over time all the way it flies. As in 3.9 the hit itself is small (a tenth of the base damage) and the debuff is the damage; its numbers are the 3.9 ratio scaled up (about 3.8 times 0.69 of the base damage a second) because Bob adds flat damage to hits and not to damage over time, which puts a lone target at the middle of the spells and leaves the pierce and the crowd as its edge.

def.name: Spirit Saw
def.description: A spinning blade that seeks enemies, saws through them, and mends your shield.

note: Throws a spectral copy of the shield: one projectile that does not pierce, whose damage comes from the shield; where it hits it shatters into shards that fly all round, pierce, and deal 25% less.

def.name: Ghost Shard
def.description: Throws a spectral shield that shatters into shards where it hits.

note: While channelling, each use makes an orb at a spot near the target place; for 1.2 s it jumps about the place every 0.4 s, exploding in a small area after each jump. Let go, and every orb left explodes in a larger area, for 75% more damage for each jump it still had.

def.name: Thunder Spiral
def.description: Channel to send orbs of lightning jumping about the target place; let go and they all burst.

note: A counter-attack that triggers by itself when the character blocks with a shield: a cone of blades in front, at most once in 0.4 seconds.

def.name: Blade Wind
def.description: When you block with your shield, a cone of blades answers in front of you.

note: A slam, mostly fire: each use has a 35% chance to spend a Grit charge for a Charged Slam, 60% more damage over more ground.

def.name: Magma Crack
def.description: A slam that splits the ground into rivers of fire; now and then it spends a Grit charge to hit much harder.

note: A piercing arrow flies to the target place; on arriving it scatters three arrows in all directions.

def.name: Whirl Shot
def.description: A piercing arrow that flies to the target place and scatters arrows all round when it arrives.

note: Arrows rain around the target (five of them) and each leaves a spore pod: for a second it afflicts the enemies near it with chaos damage over time and slows them a tenth (six pods at most), then it bursts for the arrow's damage.

def.name: Venom Shower
def.description: Arrows fall around the target, each leaving a spore pod that poisons and slows, then bursts.

note: A poisonous blade that pierces everything and returns, dealing a quarter as much on the way back; the character catches each one that returns (thirty at most, for twelve seconds), and Whirling Blades sends what was caught outward in a spiral.

def.name: Toxin Circle
def.description: A spinning blade that poisons, comes back, and is caught.

note: A weighty blow that fortifies the character: used once every four seconds, or again at once by spending an Endurance-style (Grit) charge.

def.name: Guarded Strike
def.description: A weighty blow that makes you Fortified. It waits four seconds between uses, unless you spend a Grit charge.

note: A blast of frost around the caster (or around up to five of the character’s Glacier Darts, with 20% less area) that leaves a vortex chilling and burning what is in it for three seconds; it has a short cooldown.

def.name: Blizzard Ring
def.description: A whirl of frost that sits where you place it and chills everything in it.

note: A wave of physical force, a quarter of it turned to fire and a quarter to lightning; each enemy it hits is exposed to the element it took the most damage from (25% less resistance for four seconds).

def.name: Tide of Judgement
def.description: A wave of force that breaks over the enemies in front of you and leaves them exposed to the element that hurt them most.

note: All the weapon’s physical damage becomes a random element for each use (fire, cold or lightning, equally likely); after the strike, fire makes an explosion about the enemy, cold sends three icy projectiles through everything ahead, and lightning arcs from it to the enemies near.

def.name: Prime Splash
def.description: A strike that turns into a random element, and then bursts, chills or arcs from its target.

note: A channelled orb that hangs over the character and pelts the ground around with cold explosions. Each use builds a stage (ten at most); stages lengthen the orb by a quarter and quicken its volleys by 15%, and channelling doubles the rate. Let go, and the stages fade over what is left of the orb's time.

def.name: Hoarfrost Mote
def.description: Channel to hold an orb of frost over you that pelts the enemies near with exploding ice; the longer you channel, the longer it lasts and the faster it fires.

note: A chaos spell that does no damage itself: while enemies are near it goes on hindering them (30% to 36% slower) and withering them, each stack making them take 6% more chaos damage, up to fifteen stacks.

def.name: Rot Touch
def.description: A rotting touch that slows the enemies near you and leaves them open to chaos, stack on stack.
